domain: Template Quality Assurance, Workflow Curation & ROI Modeling

heuristics.name: Minimum 10x ROI Value Gate
heuristics.rule: Every paid template must save at least 10 hours of manual engineering or $300/mo in equivalent SaaS fees. Templates offering trivial single-step actions must be offered for free as lead magnets.
heuristics.impact: Maintains 5-star marketplace rating and eliminates refund requests.

heuristics.name: Deterministic Node & Error-Handling Validation
heuristics.rule: Every n8n and Make blueprint must include explicit error-handling branches (e.g. retry on rate-limit, fallback alerting node) before being approved for public sale.
